description: 30 realistic STeP employee prompts for routing, context-budget, authority, and real-usage Pilot testing.
notes: Automated benchmark validates routing/context/authority preflight only.
Human Pilot must still judge output usefulness, correctness, source traceability, and time-to-usable-output.
All prompts are synthetic and should not contain real PII or confidential documents.
Pilot tasks include realistic configured team context; teamless routing robustness should be measured separately.
